description: This file defines IPC message-related classes and types within the Thunder::Core::IPC namespace, including scalar types, text, and buffer types, with external dependencies on Module.h, Portability.h, and Frame.h.

classes.name: ScalarType
classes.description: Template class for scalar types, specialized for string type, providing serialization and value access.

classes.name: ScalarType<string>
classes.description: Specialization of ScalarType for string, with serialization and deserialization methods.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Template class for fixed-length text handling, including copying, assignment, and serialization.

classes.name: BufferType
classes.description: Template class for buffer management, wrapping around Core::FrameType, with serialization support.

methods.name: ScalarType(const SCALAR data)
methods.description: Constructor initializing ScalarType with a scalar value.

methods.name: Length()
methods.description: Returns the length of the text in characters.

methods.name: Deserialize()
methods.description: Deserializes data from a byte stream into the object.

methods.name: Serialize()
methods.description: Serializes the object into a byte stream.

methods.name: Size()
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer.
